name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. DUB prefers direct MKV. SUB uses the shared Limitless FlixCloud proxy with query-free path payloads, token-preserving HLS rewriting, live XOR-mask discovery, and decoded FlixCloud media segments.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME and FlixCloud reference implementations
